items.title: Calida Financial builds embedded finance platform
items.snippet: Payments company, Calida Financial, has built an embedded finance platform that enables payment accounts to be used directly for contactless transactions, without a physical or virtual card. In collaboration with Bluecode, this enables partners to rapidly scale European payment products worldwide at more than 260 million acceptance points via NFC and QR code.

Only personal Google Accounts are supported during the preview - Google Workspace accounts are not yet supported.
